title: What is RAG?

body.text: search your data first, then answer
based on it, instead of answering from general knowledge. This makes answers match your documents/knowledge base and reduces hallucination.

example: Give the AI a product manual → ask 'how to reset model X' → it answers from the real manual, no guessing

title: What is it good for?

body.text: — company documents, manuals, policies, FAQs. You can build a customer chatbot grounded in your organization's real data. The key is that the data is up to date and well organized.

example: Build an employee FAQ assistant grounded in all your HR documents → it answers policy questions accurately
